implementation_state: The audited Core, Account, ML, and NewAPI feature suites passed. This node covers one point in the feature matrix — every feature switched on — and until the matrix gate existed it was the only feature-shaped check in the project, which is how two separate defects lived in the combinations it never reached.
unblock_condition: Rerun after any feature or contract change.
notes: Feature-enabled tests do not prove external lifecycle.

`cargo test --workspace --all-features` enables everything and therefore cannot see a defect that exists only when a feature is off. E-115 was one such defect and the account maintenance work introduced a second (`--features newapi` alone did not compile, because `panel_adapter` and `panel_root` were gated on `account-maint`). Both times every gate was green. The matrix gate closes that gap; this node's own command cannot, and saying otherwise here is what the record must not do.

`zroutery-core` does not compile without `ml`: `server/mod.rs` reads `config.ml_routing` unconditionally. Pre-existing, verified against the branch point, recorded as an exemption in the matrix gate rather than fixed, because the fix is a `#[cfg]` decision about the learning stack.
